## AILAB hub

This repository belongs to the airobotics-ailab organization. Its index is [AILAB_DASHBOARD](https://github.com/airobotics-ailab/AILAB_DASHBOARD).

- When discovering an owner or the modules/systems a task crosses, read its relevant `llms.txt` entries (private: `gh api repos/airobotics-ailab/AILAB_DASHBOARD/contents/llms.txt -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw'`) and `bindings/<repo>.md`. Reuse current discovery for a known owner; ordinary local edits need no repeated organization lookup. This repository's line there gives its program, the domain modules it combines and the system it belongs to — a system's repositories are developed, deployed and used as one, never a component in isolation.
- Repositories are composable domain modules. Before creating one in airobotics-ailab, apply its `docs/REPO_POLICY.md`: work that overlaps an existing module goes into that module as a directory.
- Lab machines, who may use them and what not to touch: its `HARDWARE.md`.
- 쪽지 (messages): when a session starts, check whether the person you work for has unread 쪽지 on the AILAB research server — `gh api repos/airobotics-ailab/AILAB_DASHBOARD/contents/data/messages/waiting.json -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw'` lists counts and senders per GitHub login (yours: `gh api user --jq .login`). If any wait, open your first reply with «잠시만요, 쪽지가 왔어요» and the count and senders, and point them to the research server's 쪽지 tab.
- Keep machine-specific paths and connection details out of commits and never commit credentials; sharing where a working copy lives needs its owner's approval (its `docs/WORKSPACE_REGISTRATION.md`).
